next.reason: 1985: a figurative constant as literal-1 or literal-2 'refers to an implicit one character data item whose usage is DISPLAY'. §2023:14.9.43.4 GR2: 'it refers to an implicit one character data item whose usage shall be the same as the usage of identifier-3, either display or national'; §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 restates the one-character length. 1985 SR2 requires identifier-3 to be USAGE DISPLAY, so for every 1985 program the 2023 rule yields the same one-character DISPLAY item; the national branch is reachable only through national operands, which §2023:14.9.43.3 SR1 adds and 1985 lacks. A conforming 1985 program means the same.
